blocks.text:
Motivation
• The response of flames to the electric field has strong dependence
on the electrode geometry (1g and µg).
• Experiments show that an applied e-field creates a body force
similar to that of gravity.
• High-fidelity numerical simulations are needed to provide a deeper
understanding of these observations.
11th US National Meeting CI. March 24-27, 2019. clopezca@uci.edu 4

blocks.text:
Summary
• There are indications that the model will be able to reproduce accurately the I-V curves obtained
experimentally.
• The I-V curves obtained are showing an agreement with the experiments by less than a 30%
difference in the sub-saturation domain, but there remains some further analysis of the
simulation results and physical understanding on how to capture the transition to saturation
accurately.
• Further simulations are needed to test if the model will predict the saturation region plateau of the
I-V curve.
• Future ion characterization will help explain the behavior of ions and determine what produces the
valley in the current density downstream of the jet burner. This characterization will be valuable
also to observe in detail the charge flux.
11th US National Meeting CI. March 24-27, 2019. clopezca@uci.edu 15
